provenance.source: Renault Sport, Clio Cup website: The new Clio Cup makes its entrance (30 September 2012)
provenance.notes: Race version of the new Clio Renaultsport 200 EDC (fourth generation of the Clio), built at the Alpine factory in Dieppe; first season in 2013.

provenance.source: Renault Sport Racing, Clio Cup website: New Clio Cup, Rally and RX available to order (8 November 2019)
provenance.notes: New generation of the Clio Cup, based on the fifth Clio with the 1.3 litre turbo engine; orders from November 2019 and deliveries from the first quarter of 2020. Used as the start of the Clio V generation and as the end of the Clio IV one.

provenance.source: Renault Sport Racing, Clio Cup website: Clio Cup, Clio Rally, Clio RX: variations on the same theme (22 June 2019)
provenance.notes: Presentation of the Clio V based Clio Cup at the 2019 French Grand Prix.
